name: 予定工数と実績計測の表
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct ONLY the icon fine details in image1 using ORIGINAL image2 as the exact silhouette, enclosure, optical stroke and size authority. Preserve every Japanese word, both rows, white surface and all other layout.
Clock and stopwatch should be the original TINY thin-outline glyphs about11px optical height at600px logical component width, stroke about0.8px. Current icons are too thick and prominent; reduce their optical weight and size.
Clock row1: thin circle, original two clock hands.
Stopwatch row2: reproduce EXACT original stopwatch silhouette from image2 including its small top button and source detail. Do NOT invent symmetrical side buttons; remove the extra upper-left protruding knob in image1. Use only the source-defined outline/knob details.
Play action row2: thin circular outline enclosing a SMALL HOLLOW outlined right-facing triangle, white interior. Current solid green triangle is wrong. Preserve circular enclosure and use source thin optical stroke. Brand green #1F6444 allowed for outline; no filled triangle.
Keep「項目」「予定工数」「予定工数を追加」「実績工数」「実績を追加」「計測を開始」unchanged, all regular Meiryo typography. No new controls, time values, extra rows, gray panels or decorative content.
reviewNotes: 時計の細線と中抜き再生三角に改善し全文日本語を再確認。ストップウォッチの上部細部は原本より標準化され、元の微細形状への一致はまだ確認できない。列比と外側余白にも残差。訂正2版を保持し詳細修正待ち。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
